q: Find the odd one out: AB, DE, GH, JK, NP
exp: The pairs should be consecutive letters: AB, DE, GH, JK, MN. NP is not a consecutive pair.

q: Find the odd one out: CEG, IKM, OQS, UWY, ABD
exp: CEG, IKM, OQS and UWY consist of letters with gaps of 2. ABD has consecutive gaps of 1 and 2, so it is the odd one out.

q: Find the odd one out: TABLE, CHAIR, SOFA, APPLE
exp: TABLE, CHAIR and SOFA are pieces of furniture. APPLE is a fruit, so it is the odd one out.

q: Find the odd one out: ROSE, LOTUS, LILY, WHEAT
exp: ROSE, LOTUS and LILY are commonly classified as flowers. WHEAT is a cereal crop.

q: Find the odd one out: MANGO, APPLE, BANANA, CARROT
exp: MANGO, APPLE and BANANA are fruits. CARROT is a vegetable.

q: Find the odd one out: SQUARE, CIRCLE, TRIANGLE, CUBE
exp: Square, circle and triangle are two-dimensional shapes. Cube is a three-dimensional solid.

q: Find the odd one out: COPPER, IRON, GOLD, WOOD
exp: Copper, iron and gold are metals. Wood is not a metal.

q: Find the odd one out: MONDAY, TUESDAY, FRIDAY, JANUARY
exp: Monday, Tuesday and Friday are days of the week. January is a month.

q: Find the odd one out: MOTHER, SISTER, BROTHER, COUSIN
exp: Mother, sister and brother are direct family relations in the immediate family. Cousin is an extended-family relation.
